verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is a 2FA authenticator app, so push-based sign-in with phishing defenses is a fair question for this kind of product, as competing authenticators offer push approval. The evidence only documents TOTP/HOTP codes added by QR scan or setup key, plus backups, sharing and lock screens. Nothing shows push notifications, number matching, location context, or admin-enforced MFA policies.
